decisions: Current modular actors; imported receiver limbs preserve root/grip authority
Contact and interruption outrank decorative motion
Use isolated single punches, not a multi-hit clip mislabeled as jab
Contact timing still must match simulation
Airborne actions never choose grounded sweeps
Separate from strength; use explicit body weight and volume scale
Legacy pickup/collision mass agreement is tested
Resilience affects damage threshold; impulse remains separate
Tuning is game units, not medical physics
Explicit impactDrive for flight bracing; flight motion retains existing controller
Does not grant infinite mass or automatic grabs
Compact right overlay, grid space separate from weight
Live inventory overhaul follows interaction work
Two hands = one stored item, both equipped hand slots
Carried world objects are not backpack items
Physical device and interruption integration later
Chase camera attached to valid occupied vehicle seat
Never leave player and vehicle controls active together
Heart health; bolt energy; shield defense, accessible exact resource labels
Armor mitigation is not the guard meter
Confirmed major events; existing SpeechGate cooldowns; real recordings only
Candidate text does not imply spoken audio
Current kit remains until contact review
Black shaft, crimson head; steer, embed, recall; one object per owner
Normal spear remains separate ballistic type
Export from user Unreal staging project as sources arrive
Engine install is not game migration
Defer expanded destruction and cover shooting
Focus on flight, melee and pickups

equipment.name: M24 MARKSMAN RIFLE
equipment.notes: Bolt-action 7.62. One shot, one long second to work the bolt, and almost no spread. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: M107 ANTI-MATERIEL
equipment.notes: .50 calibre. It is not built for people — it is built for what people hide behind. Defeats armour. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: AK PATTERN RIFLE
equipment.notes: 7.62 short. Hits harder than the M16 and wanders more doing it. Never jams. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: M16 RIFLE
equipment.notes: 5.56. Lighter round, faster cycle, and it goes where you point it. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: KUCHLER MK I
equipment.notes: Fictional compact rifle from War World: Earth. Thirty rounds, a detachable magazine, and standard service-rifle handling. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: BATTLE RIFLE
equipment.notes: Full-power 7.62 in a semi-automatic. Fewer shots that matter more. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: SQUAD AUTOMATIC
equipment.notes: Belt-fed. It does not out-damage a rifle per shot; it simply does not stop. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: MP5 SUBMACHINE GUN
equipment.notes: 9mm, closed bolt, very controllable. Devastating in a corridor, useless across a plaza. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: SUPPRESSED PDW
equipment.notes: Subsonic and suppressed. Half the noise radius — the block does not hear you working. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: COMBAT SHOTGUN
equipment.notes: 12 gauge, eight pellets, and a short life on every one — the falloff is physical, not a curve. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: AUTO SHOTGUN
equipment.notes: Six pellets a shell and no pump. Empties fast, and everything in front of it knows. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: 9MM SIDEARM
equipment.notes: What everyone actually carries. Accurate, quiet-ish, and it will not stop anything armoured. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: .44 REVOLVER
equipment.notes: Six rounds that hit like a rifle, and a cylinder you have to think about. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: MACHINE PISTOL
equipment.notes: A sidearm with the safety filed off. Spread like a hose past ten metres. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: BASEBALL BAT
equipment.notes: A two-handed wooden bat. Sweep the barrel through the target, then recover your grip. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: KATANA
equipment.notes: A long single edge. Reach and a deep cut — it wounds where a fist only bruises. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: CLAWS
equipment.notes: Three edges on each hand. Fast, shallow, and they stack wounds faster than anything else. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: COMBAT KNIFE
equipment.notes: Short, quiet, and always there. The weapon you have when the rifle is empty. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: BREACHING TOMAHAWK
equipment.notes: A door tool that is also an axe. Heavy, slow, and it does not care about a guard. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: RIOT BATON
equipment.notes: Not meant to kill. Meant to make somebody stop, and it staggers rather than cuts. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: GREAT BLADE
equipment.notes: Two hands, enormous reach, and a wind-up you can read from across the street. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: CS GAS GRENADE
equipment.notes: Blinds and doubles you over. Almost no damage — it is here to move people, not kill them. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: MUSTARD CANISTER
equipment.notes: A blister agent. Slow, cruel, and it eats armour — the one thing a plated chassis fears. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: SMOKE GRENADE
equipment.notes: No damage at all. It takes away the one thing every shooter needs. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: FLASHBANG
equipment.notes: Staggers, and wipes what a bot believed about where you were. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: FRAG GRENADE
equipment.notes: The honest one. A canister, a fuse, and a radius. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: BREACHING CHARGE
equipment.notes: Shaped, directional, and meant for a wall rather than a person. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: DIRECTIONAL MINE
equipment.notes: Faces one way. Placed well it wins a corridor; placed badly it does nothing at all. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: NIGHT VISION GOGGLES
equipment.notes: Amplifies what little light there is. The night stops being cover — and a flashbang becomes far worse. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: MOTION DETECTOR
equipment.notes: Pings anything MOVING, through walls. Stand still and it never sees you — which cuts both ways. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: THERMAL SCOPE
equipment.notes: Bodies burn through the walls, and they leave a trail where they ran. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: BALLISTIC PLATE
equipment.notes: An ablative pool that eats bullets first. Consumed by what it stops. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: RIOT SHIELD
equipment.notes: Frontal cover you carry. It is the reason a line of officers can walk forward. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: TRAUMA KIT
equipment.notes: Stops a bleed and buys back some hull. It cannot regrow an arm. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: RAPPEL LINE
equipment.notes: A roof is a position. This is how a person without powers gets to one. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: COMMS JAMMER
equipment.notes: Cuts squad radio — bots stop sharing what they have seen and fight on their own eyes. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: EXTRACTION BEACON
equipment.notes: Plant it, and later be back at it from anywhere. Base action damage is before target defenses; footprint is not weight.

equipment.name: Crimson Guided Spear
equipment.notes: One hand; same physical object through throw/embed/recall. Does not replace an existing hero kit.
